text.message: Read settings and plan files through read_user_file or read_or_backup, so a broken file never stops the app.

lessons.message: Numbers here come from files the user edits: refuse 0, negative and missing values with a plain error, like positive_speed and miner_rate do.
A miner's clock is what it pulls divided by its own rate, never by a rate already cut to the belt (that showed 50% where 12.5% was right).
